title: An Automated and Reproducible Workflow for Crack Identification and Damage Assessment of Fusion Materials
abstract: arXiv:2610.03505v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-exposure microscopy is central to qualification of fusion materials. However, manual analysis does not scale to the volume, heterogeneity, and multiresolution character of modern fusion-materials campaigns. To address this challenge, we present a reproducible workflow, implemented in the Galaxy scientific workflow environment, for automated crack identification and quantitative damage assessment from scanning electron microscopy images. The workflow processes SEM images and experimental metadata to identify cracks, quantify damage, and retain the intermediate products and processing history needed for reproducibility. Outputs include crack masks, skeletonized crack networks, quality-control visualizations, and scalar damage descriptors. translated_title: 聚变材料裂纹识别与损伤评估的自动化可复现工作流程
translated_abstract: 辐照后显微分析是聚变材料合格评定的核心环节。然而，人工分析无法适应现代聚变材料研究活动中数据量大、异质性强和多分辨率的特点。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种在Galaxy科学工作流环境中实现的可复现工作流程，用于从扫描电子显微镜图像中自动识别裂纹并进行定量损伤评估。该工作流程处理SEM图像和实验元数据以识别裂纹、量化损伤，并保留复现所需的中间产物和处理历史。输出内容包括裂纹掩膜、骨架化裂纹网络、质量控制可视化以及标量损伤描述符。该方法旨在无需针对具体图像进行参数调优的情况下，适用于不同牌号的钨材料、不同微观结构、不同放大倍数和不同损伤状态。我们在稀疏电子-（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文在Galaxy科学工作流环境中实现了一个自动化可复现的裂纹识别与损伤评估流程，无需图像特定参数调优即可处理不同钨材料、微观结构、放大倍数和损伤状态的扫描电镜图像。
en_tdlr: The paper presents an automated, reproducible workflow in the Galaxy environment that identifies cracks and quantifies damage in fusion material SEM images without image-specific parameter tuning, across tungsten grades, microstructures, magnifications, and damage states.
